ambiguities: Animal cartoons are a native faithful redraw, not an exact reproduction of original printed contour pixels. Curve details are hand-authored; identity, chirality, colored identity cues and directed artwork axes are preserved.
Only visible faces are rendered. The unseen face assignment is inferred exclusively for the mathematical audit, never drawn.
